en.t: That evening's meal was made of grain food.

units.source_text: 是又黑又重的面包加热菜，仅此而已。

en.t: It was nothing more than dark, heavy bread with hot vegetables.

units.source_text: 幸亏是周末，下午开始休息，该出门的人已经出门了。

en.t: Fortunately it was the weekend; the break had begun in the afternoon, and those who were going out had already gone.

units.source_text: 今晚是在庙内就在，可以早题，也可以外出到晚上十一点，

en.t: Tonight, if one stayed inside the temple, one could go to bed early, or one could go out until eleven at night,

units.source_text: 而且翌晨可以睡懒觉，称做"睡过时间"。

en.t: and the next morning one could sleep late, which was called "oversleeping time."
The teacher had also gone out long before.
